defects.title: Consequential ordinary checkout/check-in caller and test research deferred to future validation
defects.evidence_context: API checkout lines 1444–1462 and UI store 172–190 lock and recheck inside transactions. API checkin 1480–1564 and UI store 95–237 disassociate the assignee and accept status_id before saving and emitting a check-in event. The inherited checkin permission policy checks permission, not availableForCheckIn(). UI tests include an already non-deployable check-in page and submission to a non-deployable status.
defects.why_material: The brief explicitly requires consequential primary code/caller/test research. These available mechanisms directly affect the two-volunteer and maintenance-hold comparison. Leaving them entirely for later product tests omits obtainable research, even though uncertainty is honestly declared. No installation or future execution is required to inspect them.
